evidence.name: Screen field: Auto-Advance After A Delay
evidence.userNeed: Know what "Auto-Advance After A Delay" controls and when to adjust it while editing a screen.

sections.title: Auto-Advance After A Delay
sections.description: When on, the screen moves to the next step on its own after the countdown you set below, with a visible timer. Off by default. Great for splash or 'analyzing...' screens, but never use it where visitors must tap or answer, like questions or your paywall, or you'll skip them past the response or sale.
